template: Open {{v1}} in the browser. If the Grafana sign-in page appears, sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} - type the exact text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} into the password field (the real password is filled in as it is typed); do not try any other password. If Grafana asks you to update or change the admin password after login, skip that step. Then open the provisioned dashboard named Service health (use the search menu or the Dashboards browse page to find it). Report the exact titles of all panels shown on that dashboard, exactly as displayed on screen.
